narrationTexts: Confirmed: only `order totals` fails, tax is applied to the pre-discount amount instead of the discounted one.
finalText:
**Suite is green: 625 passing, 0 failing.**

`orderTotal` was taxing the pre-discount amount instead of the discounted one.

Fixed in [src/pricing.js:39](src/pricing.js:39) by taxing `discounted` via `applyTax` instead of `cents`.

No other suites were broken.
